queries.query: Recent reporting from anywhere in the world about strikes, workplace occupations, union organizing, wildcat labor action, general strikes, or large worker-led protests. Prefer primary statements, local reporting, and independent media; avoid duplicate syndicated copies.

Recent reporting about political repression, protest policing, arrests of activists, censorship, surveillance, restrictions on assembly, or civil-liberties conflicts connected to social movements. Prefer local sources, legal or rights organizations, and primary documents when available.

Recent reporting about tenant organizing, rent strikes, eviction resistance, occupations or squatting, community self-organization, mutual aid, food solidarity, or neighborhood campaigns. Prefer concrete local events and first-hand or local reporting.

Recent reporting about climate justice direct action, environmental resistance, anti-war mobilization, international solidarity campaigns, blockades, occupations, or mass demonstrations. Prefer concrete current events, local reporting, and primary movement sources.
